import subprocess

# Read current file
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "show", "HEAD:src/marshmallow/schema.py"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
content = result.stdout

# 1. Add zip_longest import after OrderedDict import
old_import = "from collections import OrderedDict, defaultdict"
new_import = "from collections import OrderedDict, defaultdict\nfrom itertools import zip_longest"
content = content.replace(old_import, new_import)

# 2. Replace zip(data, original_data) with zip_longest(data, original_data) in both places
# First occurrence (line ~1185): for idx, (item, orig) in enumerate(zip(data, original_data)):
content = content.replace(
    "for idx, (item, orig) in enumerate(zip(data, original_data)):",
    "for idx, (item, orig) in enumerate(zip_longest(data, original_data)):"
)

# Second occurrence (line ~1228): for item, original in zip(data, original_data)
content = content.replace(
    "for item, original in zip(data, original_data)",
    "for item, original in zip_longest(data, original_data)"
)

# Write back
with open('src/marshmallow/schema.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("m3 changes written")
